title: Glowing planet with rings
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='planetGrad' cx='40%' cy='35%' r='70%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffd97a'/>
      <stop offset='55%' stop-color='#ffab4a'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#e8703a'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id='ringGrad' x1='0%' y1='0%' x2='100%' y2='100%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#9be8ff'/>
      <stop offset='50%' stop-color='#5fd6ff'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#3fb2f0'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- ring back half -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='46' ry='13' fill='none' stroke='#2f8fd8' stroke-width='9' stroke-dasharray='150 200' stroke-dashoffset='-75' transform='rotate(-18 50 52)' opacity='0.95'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='46' ry='13' fill='none' stroke='url(#ringGrad)' stroke-width='6' stroke-dasharray='150 200' stroke-dashoffset='-75' transform='rotate(-18 50 52)'/>

  <!-- planet body -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='52' r='26' fill='url(#planetGrad)'/>
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='44' rx='9' ry='5' fill='#fff0c2' opacity='0.55'/>
  <path d='M33 62 q8 6 18 4' stroke='#d65a2e' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.7'/>
  <path d='M52 38 q9 2 12 8' stroke='#fff0c2' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.6'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='66' r='4' fill='#d65a2e' opacity='0.55'/>

  <!-- ring front half -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='46' ry='13' fill='none' stroke='#2f8fd8' stroke-width='9' stroke-dasharray='150 200' stroke-dashoffset='0' transform='rotate(-18 50 52)' opacity='0.95'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='46' ry='13' fill='none' stroke='url(#ringGrad)' stroke-width='6' stroke-dasharray='150 200' stroke-dashoffset='0' transform='rotate(-18 50 52)'/>

  <!-- sparkles -->
  <circle cx='18' cy='24' r='2' fill='#bff4ff'/>
  <circle cx='83' cy='30' r='2.5' fill='#bff4ff'/>
  <circle cx='76' cy='78' r='2' fill='#bff4ff'/>
  <circle cx='24' cy='80' r='1.6' fill='#bff4ff'/>
</svg>
